items.title: Percy Heath — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: INTERVIEWER: What you were referring to is the soundtrack from Kemek turned out was Plastic Dreams... [INTERVIEWEE] Who did it? Yeah, I don’t know, some artist brought it in and it was approved.

ctx.x: I don’t know who did the notes, but when you engage somebody to do liner notes and their descriptions of the music are not necessarily the intent of the composer, it’s another incident of trying to verbalize an intangible. You know what I mean? What label they put on it… I don’t know. I do have the album here somewhere. You read all these notes, I probably never read the liner notes.
[laughs] What you were referring to is the soundtrack from Kemek turned out was Plastic Dreams, now you gotta tell me, what was the deal with the album cover? Who thought of that?
Who did it? Yeah, I don’t know, some artist brought it in and it was approved.
